FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.

2. When practising Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information.

3. When practising Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive listening 1.3 Active listening 1.4 Listening for information.

   C. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking Turn taking Vocabulary Engagement Questioning.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking Turn taking Vocabulary Engagement Questioning.

7. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.

8. “Bonjour” is used to say: (1 mark)
   A. Good morning / hello
   B. Excuse me
   C. Thank you
   D. Good night only

9. The French word for “book” is: (1 mark)
   A. porte
   B. livre
   C. chaise
   D. fenêtre

10. When practising Listening for understanding Identifying key points Vocabulary Attention, which approach is best? (1 mark)
